AI-Mini-Drama-02.title: Public-figure reference photo is not blocked
AI-Mini-Drama-02.short: PDR-I 16.9.0 - [AIAgent] AI Mini Drama: Public-figure reference photo is not blocked and a lookalike is generated
AI-Mini-Drama-02.desc:
Repro Steps:
1. Launch the APP
2. Open AI Mini Drama and start a custom idea to reach the cast step
3. Tap a character slot, then Create my character
4. Add a photo of a well-known public figure as Reference and set Gender, Ethnicity and Age
5. Tap Generate
6. Check the result

Result:
The public-figure photo is accepted and a character resembling that person is generated.
摘要：名人照片未被阻擋，並生成與本人相似的角色。
{16.9.0_amd02_celebrity_ref.jpg} {16.9.0_amd02_lookalike.jpg}

Expect Result:
The photo is blocked with This photo can't be used and no character is generated.
摘要：應顯示 This photo can't be used 並阻止生成。
Spec string: 「This photo can't be used」/「It looks like a real public figure. Please try another photo.」

Note:
Device: iPhone 17 Air / iOS 26.2.1
Spec Link: AI Mini Drama PM spec, Main flow board - https://www.figma.com/design/44RyrcOcWi2MvhGci9bO5F/AI-Mini-Drama?node-id=2016-2
<Claude Reviewed>
AI-Mini-Drama-02.qa_note: Used the existing device-library portrait of a well-known athlete (Shohei Ohtani, Dodgers). The app generated a front/side/back character that closely resembles him and offered Save to library, charging ◆4. It also ignored Gender: Female. Spec R-046 (PM main flow) requires blocking with 「This photo can't be used」. Likeness/legal risk, so S2.

AI-Mini-Drama-03.title: Failed character generation is silent
AI-Mini-Drama-03.short: PDR-I 16.9.0 - [AIAgent] AI Mini Drama: Failed character generation shows no error, no ! mark and no refund notice
AI-Mini-Drama-03.desc:
Repro Steps:
1. Launch the APP
2. Open AI Mini Drama, start a custom idea with 3 characters
3. Tap a character slot, tap ✓, then Generate all
4. When one character fails, check the sheet
5. Tap Generate for the failed one and check again
6. Check the result

Result:
Failed characters silently return to the unset state; no error message, no ! mark, refund not shown.
摘要：角色生成失敗時無任何提示，直接回到未設定狀態。
{16.9.0_amd03_generate_all.jpg} {16.9.0_amd03_partial_silent.jpg} {16.9.0_amd03_single_silent.jpg}

Expect Result:
Failed slots show ! and Couldn't create image with the refund note, as in the Design spec.
摘要：失敗角色應顯示 ! 及 Couldn't create image 與退點說明。
Spec string: 「Couldn't create image」/「We couldn't create this character and your credits have been refunded. Try again later.」

Note:
Device: iPhone 17 Air / iOS 26.2.1
Spec Link: AI Mini Drama Design spec, Characters: Flow, Create my character, Filter, Error board - https://www.figma.com/design/dZk5HLzZTdcZwWwvN9aZfZ/AI-Mini-Drama?node-id=116-7873
Spec Link: AI Mini Drama PM spec, Update board 3 board - https://www.figma.com/design/44RyrcOcWi2MvhGci9bO5F/AI-Mini-Drama?node-id=2016-2
<Claude Reviewed>
AI-Mini-Drama-03.qa_note: Triggered with Pink › [z] AI Mini Drama › Trip image moderation = 1. Generate all ◆12 for 3 characters: 2 applied, 1 failed, and the sheet just went back to 「1 character isn't set yet」 (no 「!」, no 「Couldn't create some images」). Single Generate ◆4: also silent, no 「Couldn't create image」 dialog. Credits: 5908 → 5899 (−9 for 2 successes at ◆4, expected −8) and 5899 → 5898 (−1 on a failed single), so refunds look wrong too — included here rather than as a separate ticket. Specs: PM 10/2 §13.10 (partial) and PM error handling (single).

AI-Mini-Drama-04.title: Failed chat turns end silently
AI-Mini-Drama-04.short: PDR-I 16.9.0 - [AIAgent][UX] AI Mini Drama: Failed chat turn ends silently with no error message or Try again
AI-Mini-Drama-04.desc:
Repro Steps:
1. Launch the APP
2. Turn on Pink › AI Mini Drama › Inject failure status = tool_error
3. Open AI Mini Drama, send an idea and confirm the cast
4. Wait for the reply and check the result
5. Check the result

Result:
The turn shows Continuing the drama production. and then ends with no message or retry option.
摘要：對話回合失敗後無任何錯誤訊息或重試按鈕。
{16.9.0_amd04_after_cast.jpg} {16.9.0_amd04_after_request.jpg}

Expect Result:
A failed turn shows the Something went wrong on my end message with Try again.
摘要：應顯示錯誤訊息並提供 Try again。
Spec string: 「Something went wrong on my end. Let's try that again.」

Note:
Device: iPhone 17 Air / iOS 26.2.1
Spec Link: AI Mini Drama Design spec, Extra board board - https://www.figma.com/design/dZk5HLzZTdcZwWwvN9aZfZ/AI-Mini-Drama?node-id=116-7873
Spec Link: AI Mini Drama PM spec, Error Handling board - https://www.figma.com/design/44RyrcOcWi2MvhGci9bO5F/AI-Mini-Drama?node-id=2016-2
<Claude Reviewed>
AI-Mini-Drama-04.qa_note: Server failure injected with Pink 「Inject failure status = tool_error」 (scope First beat). Two turns failed: confirming the cast (should offer the storyboard) and the typed request 「Create the storyboard」. Each showed 「Continuing the drama production.」 then simply ended — no error, no Try again — leaving the user with nothing to tap. Pink 「Fail every call」 alone did not fail the outline turn. Spec: PM error handling (5xxx copy).

AI-Mini-Drama-05.title: Video stage reached without storyboard or settings
AI-Mini-Drama-05.short: PDR-I 16.9.0 - [AIAgent] AI Mini Drama: Drama jumps from characters straight to video without storyboard or settings
AI-Mini-Drama-05.desc:
Repro Steps:
1. Launch the APP
2. Open AI Mini Drama, create a custom drama and set the cast
3. Type Create the storyboard after a failed turn
4. Reopen the drama from History and check the result
5. Check the result

Result:
The chat shows Here's your drama. with a failed clip; no storyboard, video settings or price came first.
摘要：未經分鏡與影片設定，直接進入影片結果。
{16.9.0_amd05_cast_only.jpg} {16.9.0_amd05_jump_to_video.jpg}

Expect Result:
Video is only created after the storyboard and the user's video settings and price confirmation.
摘要：應先完成分鏡並由使用者選擇影片設定與價格後才生成影片。

Note:
Device: iPhone 17 Air / iOS 26.2.1
Spec Link: AI Mini Drama Design spec, Main flow board - https://www.figma.com/design/dZk5HLzZTdcZwWwvN9aZfZ/AI-Mini-Drama?node-id=116-7873
<Claude Reviewed>
AI-Mini-Drama-05.qa_note: Seen once on 「Passing the Spark」. Sequence: cast set while Pink tool_error injection was on (turn failed silently, ISS-AMD-04), then 「Create the storyboard」 typed, injection later turned off. On reopening, the chat jumped straight from Characters Result to 「Here's your drama.」 with one failed clip — no storyboard, no Storyboard Preview, no video settings, no price, no charge. Reproduced 1/1; it may need the injected failure to trigger. Proposed S2 because it bypasses the paid confirmation step; downgrade if RD confirms it only follows injected failures.

AI-Mini-Drama-06.title: Chat image update fails silently
AI-Mini-Drama-06.short: PDR-I 16.9.0 - [AIAgent] AI Mini Drama: Updating a storyboard image from chat fails silently and the scene never changes
AI-Mini-Drama-06.desc:
Repro Steps:
1. Launch the APP
2. Open a finished AI Mini Drama storyboard
3. Type Update the image for Scene 2 to show rain and send
4. Tap Generate on the card Iris returns
5. Wait about 5 minutes and open Scene 2
6. Check the result

Result:
The update card is Create storyboard ◆3; after Generate the progress vanishes and Scene 2 is unchanged.
摘要：聊天更新分鏡圖失敗且無提示，場景圖未更新。
{16.9.0_amd06_card.jpg} {16.9.0_amd06_progress.jpg} {16.9.0_amd06_vanished.jpg} {16.9.0_amd06_scene2_same.jpg}

Expect Result:
An Update storyboard images card appears and the updated scene shows in a new storyboard card.
摘要：應出現 Update storyboard images 卡片並完成更新。
Spec string: 「Update storyboard images」 card, 2 credits per image

Note:
Device: iPhone 17 Air / iOS 26.2.1
Spec Link: AI Mini Drama PM spec, Update board 3 board - https://www.figma.com/design/44RyrcOcWi2MvhGci9bO5F/AI-Mini-Drama?node-id=2016-2
<Claude Reviewed>
AI-Mini-Drama-06.qa_note: Office Romance, storyboard done. 「Update the image for Scene 2 to show rain」 → Iris answered 「Script updated! Regenerate the storyboard to match?」 with a 「Create storyboard」 card ◆3 (spec: an 「Update storyboard images」 card at 2 credits per image). Generate → 「Continuing mini drama production.」 skeleton for ~4.5 min, then it vanished: no new storyboard card, no message, Scene 2 unchanged. The video settings card also disappeared. After reopening, credits had dropped by 4 (5928 → 5924) with nothing produced. Specs PM 10/2 board (R-061, R-062).

AI-Mini-Drama-07.title: Credit prices differ from the spec
AI-Mini-Drama-07.short: PDR-I 16.9.0 - [AIAgent] AI Mini Drama: Character, scene image and chat update prices differ from the spec
AI-Mini-Drama-07.desc:
Repro Steps:

2. Open AI Mini Drama and create a custom drama
3. Check the prices on Finish your characters, Create my character and a failed scene's Regenerate Image
4. Check the result

Prices shown: character ◆4, Create my character ◆4, scene image 3 per image (◆6 for two).

{16.9.0_amd07_generate_all_8.jpg} {16.9.0_amd07_create_4.jpg} {16.9.0_amd07_regen_3_per_image.jpg}

Expect Result:
Design prices: character ◆6 each, Create my character ◆6, location + scene regenerate ◆12.
摘要：依 Design：角色每位 ◆6、自建角色 ◆6、場景與地點重生成 ◆12。

Note:
Device: iPhone 17 Air / iOS 26.2.1
Spec Link: AI Mini Drama Design spec, Characters: Flow, Create my character, Filter, Error board - https://www.figma.com/design/dZk5HLzZTdcZwWwvN9aZfZ/AI-Mini-Drama?node-id=116-7873
Spec Link: AI Mini Drama Design spec, Storyboard board - https://www.figma.com/design/dZk5HLzZTdcZwWwvN9aZfZ/AI-Mini-Drama?node-id=116-7873
<Claude Reviewed>
AI-Mini-Drama-07.qa_note: Prices on this build differ from the Design spec, which is the expected result where it differs from PM: character Generate ◆4 per character (Design: Generate ◆6 / Generate all ◆18 for 3); Create my character ◆4 (Design: Generate ◆6; PM had ◆7); scene Regenerate Image 「Charge 3 credits per image」, ◆6 for location + scene (Design: Regenerate Image ◆12, 6 per image). The chat image update card was ◆3 for one scene (PM: 2 per image; Design has no frame). Owner PM per reviewer: confirm whether the server prices or the spec prices are current.

AI-Mini-Drama-08.title: Leave dialog missing in template chat

AI-Mini-Drama-08.qa_note: Template path (Forbidden Office Romance): Back while the outline was 「Thinking...」 left immediately with no dialog, and the outline kept generating and was saved to History as 「Workplace Romance」 (22 KB). The custom-idea path does show the dialog (TC-026 Pass), so this is template-only.

Spec Link: AI Mini Drama PM spec, Update board 5 board - https://www.figma.com/design/44RyrcOcWi2MvhGci9bO5F/AI-Mini-Drama?node-id=2016-2

AI-Mini-Drama-14.title: Retry after a failed video is inconsistent

摘要：影片失敗後按 Try again 未重試，反而詢問要修改哪個段落。

Try again restarts video creation with the full Choose your video settings card.

Note:
Device: iPhone 17 Air / iOS 26.2.1
Spec Link: AI Mini Drama PM spec, Error Handling board - https://www.figma.com/design/44RyrcOcWi2MvhGci9bO5F/AI-Mini-Drama?node-id=2016-2

AI-Mini-Drama-14.qa_note: Off-case observations O-1 and O-2 (TC-094 itself passed: copy and Try again button are right). First Try again re-showed the video settings card.
